content_zh:
林锐心里一阵心悸，刚才只要稍微差一点，就会被一枪击中脚踝，那就真是彻底完了。不过他不出声，隐伏在遮蔽物之后。他知道，赵建飞并不清楚自己是否真的中弹，他也不能主动暴露这一点。
因为赵建飞心里没有把握，就会迟疑，而他的稍有迟疑，就是自己的机会。所以林锐一声不吭，沉默地躲避在不足一米高的遮蔽物后面。他要利用赵建飞的这种心理，为自己争取更大的机会。
赵建飞确实有些疑惑，如果刚才他这一枪已经击中了林锐，那么林锐现在应该失去行动能力了。他之所以隐伏在遮蔽物后面不开口，就是想以没有受伤的假象来迷惑和牵制自己，为其他的队友争取主动。那么的主要精力就不需要在放在林锐的身上。而是要集中注意力对付其他三个人。
但是，如果林锐没有被击中，那么他对付其余三个队员的时候，林锐就很有可能借机会再次突进。毕竟这个小子的军事素质过硬，再加上多年习武，他的那种速度和神经反应足以令人惊讶。也许他将是第一个顶着赵建飞枪口突进到接近二十米距离的人。
所以赵建飞双手举枪，却没有眯起眼瞄准。因为闭上一只眼就等于丧失了一半的视野。毕竟现在林锐和其余几个第五小队成员，已经在不同的位置上分散隐蔽。如果他们有足够的默契能够在同时分头行动，很有可能让赵建飞顾此失彼。
赵建飞冷冷地一笑道，“我还以为你们有什么本事，不过就是有些****运罢了。现在你们也只剩下四个人了，也许还只能算三个半。那个混球，你别以为自己受伤了不出声，就可以蒙混过去。想用这种方式拖住我，根本不可能。你以为自己能让我分心么？老实告诉你，别看你们在不同的位置，只要谁敢露头，老子一枪就射爆了他。”
林锐现在有些无奈，他和同伴们分开了。虽然他知道金浩山和陈南庆等人躲在哪里，但是相互之间却看不到，没有办法通过战术手语交流。当然，更不能通过喊话的方式交流，那等于告诉赵建飞自己没事。
林锐靠在遮掩物后面，突然灵机一动，他确定自己等人已经突进了将近十米左右，那就是说，赵建飞距离他们还有四十多米。这个距离他们如果说话，他肯定能够听到。但是如果采用其他的方式他却未必能够察觉。
林锐从地上摸起了一颗小石子，悄悄地敲了敲身后的遮蔽物，发出了很轻微的声音。他的敲击声音很轻但是却有着明显的节奏，“啪啪，啪啪，啪……”既要保证赵建飞听不到，又要保证金浩山和其他两个人能够察觉，这实在是个技术活。
他敲出的是摩尔斯码，这种早已被弃用的电报代码，现在已经没有多少人掌握了。但是林锐却知道金浩山是无线通讯兵出身，或许他对常用的摩尔斯有所了解。林锐这也是病急乱投医，没有办法的办法了。
果然，过了片刻，金浩山那里也传来了轻微的敲击声。林锐默默回味着这敲击的节奏，知道金浩山的意思是在询问他现在怎么样，下一步该怎么办。林锐立刻回应了他的敲击。他敲击的代码是“G”，其引申意义是go。
这个代码一发出，林锐就像一只轻盈的猫一样从遮蔽物之后跃了出来。他的行进路线经过周密的计算，冲前几步，就会做一次变向。这种高速奔跑之中的陡然变向，其实很难，但是林锐却游刃有余。少年时代的传统武术训练，让他的身体具备了极佳的柔韧性和爆发力。而后来的军旅生涯，更是训练出了他极好的战术基本功。
与之同时，金浩山等人也冲了出来。第五小队剩下的四名队员，正在以两个不同的方向发起冲锋。而在远处，却有一支随时准备击发的枪，和一双坚如磐石的双手。赵建飞“啪啪”两枪，精确无比的点射，射中陈南庆和另外一个队员。他说到做到，这一次他都是对着头部射击。
橡皮子弹打在他们的头盔上，虽然不致命却能导致突然的冲击力，足以使他们产生脑震荡而失去战斗力。

content_en:
Lin Rui felt palpitations in his heart. If he had missed even a little bit, he would have been shot in the ankle, and that would have been the end. However, he remained silent and hid behind the cover. He knew that Zhao Jianfei didn't know whether he was really shot, and he couldn't take the initiative to expose this.
Because Zhao Jianfei was not sure, he would hesitate, and his slight hesitation was his opportunity. So Lin Rui remained silent and hid behind a shelter less than one meter high. He wanted to take advantage of Zhao Jianfei's mentality to gain greater opportunities for himself.
Zhao Jianfei was indeed a little confused. If his shot had hit Lin Rui just now, Lin Rui should have lost the ability to move now. The reason why he hid behind the cover and didn't speak was because he wanted to confuse and contain himself with the illusion of not being injured, and gain the initiative for other teammates. Then the main focus does not need to be on Lin Rui. Instead, focus on dealing with the other three.
However, if Lin Rui was not hit, then when he dealt with the other three team members, Lin Rui would most likely take the opportunity to rush in again. After all, this boy has excellent military qualities, coupled with many years of martial arts training, his speed and nervous reactions are surprising. Maybe he will be the first person to rush to a distance of nearly 20 meters with Zhao Jianfei's gun.
So Zhao Jianfei raised the gun with both hands, but did not narrow his eyes and aim. Because closing one eye means losing half of your vision. After all, Lin Rui and the other members of the fifth team are already hiding in different positions. If they have enough tacit understanding to act separately at the same time, it is very likely that Zhao Jianfei will lose sight of one thing.
Zhao Jianfei smiled coldly and said, "I thought you had some ability, but you just had some luck. Now there are only four of you left, maybe only three and a half. That bastard, don't think that you can get away with it because you are injured and can't make a sound. It's impossible to hold me back in this way. Do you think you can distract me? To tell you the truth, regardless of whether you are in different positions, as long as anyone dares to show his face, I will shoot him with one shot."
Lin Rui was a little helpless now. He was separated from his companions. Although he knew where Jin Haoshan, Chen Nanqing and others were hiding, they could not see each other and had no way to communicate through tactical sign language. Of course, communication cannot be done by shouting, which is equivalent to telling Zhao Jianfei that he is fine.
Lin Rui leaned behind the cover and suddenly had an idea. He was sure that he and others had advanced nearly ten meters, which meant that Zhao Jianfei was still more than forty meters away from them. If they spoke from this distance, he would definitely be able to hear them. But if other methods are used, he may not be able to detect it.
Lin Rui picked up a pebble from the ground and quietly knocked on the shelter behind him, making a slight sound. The sound of his tapping was very soft but had an obvious rhythm, "Pah, pah, pah..." It was necessary to ensure that Zhao Jianfei could not hear it, but also to ensure that Jin Haoshan and the other two people could detect it. This was really a technical job.
What he typed was Morse code, a long-abandoned telegraph code that not many people have mastered now. But Lin Rui knew that Jin Haoshan was a wireless communications soldier, and perhaps he knew something about the commonly used Morse. Lin Rui was so sick that he rushed to the doctor because there was nothing he could do.
Sure enough, after a while, there was a slight knocking sound from Jin Haoshan. Lin Rui silently recalled the rhythm of the tapping, knowing that Jin Haoshan meant to ask how he was doing now and what to do next. Lin Rui immediately responded to his knock. The code he typed was "G", and its extended meaning was go.
As soon as this code was issued, Lin Rui jumped out from behind the cover like a light cat. His route of travel has been carefully calculated, and he will do it once if he takes a few steps forward.Change direction. This kind of sudden change of direction during high-speed running is actually very difficult, but Lin Rui is able to do it with ease. The traditional martial arts training in his youth gave his body excellent flexibility and explosive power. Later in his military career, he developed excellent basic tactical skills.
At the same time, Jin Haoshan and others also rushed out. The remaining four members of the fifth team were charging in two different directions. But in the distance, there was a gun ready to fire at any time, and a pair of rock-solid hands. Zhao Jianfei fired two shots with great accuracy, hitting Chen Nanqing and another team member. He meant what he said, and this time he shot them all in the head.
Rubber bullets hitting their helmets, although not fatal, can cause a sudden impact that is enough to cause concussions and render them incompetent.
